[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ever since I've gotten this stuff it's been my go to SPF serum and I've been incorporating it into my morning skin care routine. It also smells so good, but it's not overpowering and it goes away as soon as it's absorbed. It promises up to 48 hours of hydration as well. I appreciate that it's incorporated niacinamide (brightens and tones) and hyaluronic acid (plumps and hydrates) into its mixture, which has saved me time and money since it condenses 3 of my usual products into 1 bottle. I've noticed a huge improvement in the look and feel of my skin overtime. I used to have uneven skin tone and texture, but it has now noticeably smoothed out! I'm now seeing the difference between saving yourself a few bucks by buying a cheaper product, and actually investing in higher end products, because not even the products I used before this were able to give me these results. I will continue to use and buy this stuff until I find something that works better! Give this a try if you're looking to upgrade your SPF with skincare incorporated into it!

avis.titre: One stop solution for serum and sunscreen

It feels more like a serum than sunscreen, lightweight, invisible (no white cast), and leaves a radiant glow. It hydrates like crazy (my skin actually feels soft all day), and the combo of niacinamide, vitamin Cg, and hyaluronic acid has helped fade some dark spots already. These are my favorite ingredients in any skincare products. Plus, I love the packaging! The compact, sleek bottle with that glowy Lancôme logo? Super cute and totally travel-friendly. The only thing I wish could be improved is the longevity, I can't reapply serum based sunscreen every 2-hours on my makeup. Now in that case, I have to invest in a setting spray that has spf 50+. Overall, an amazing product to minimize skincare routine steps.
